name: Leadership
definition: Events where a person holds a position of authority, such as a president, governor, leader, or chief.

name: Personnel
definition: Events describing a person's role, rank, or title, such as a soldier, sailor, professor, or student.

name: Transaction
definition: Events involving the exchange of goods or services, such as buying, selling, or purchasing.

name: Marriage
definition: Events describing the act of getting married or the state of being married.

name: Conflict
definition: Events involving physical or verbal confrontation, such as protests, rapes, or challenging someone.

name: Competition
definition: Events related to contests, awards, and victories, such as winning a medal or an election.

name: Employment
definition: Events related to a person's work, job, or artistic output.

name: Arts
definition: Events related to the creation or production of artistic works, such as films or music.

name: Communication
definition: Events involving the transmission of information, such as sending messages or commands.

name: Kinship
definition: Events describing family relationships, such as being a spouse or sibling.

name: Movement
definition: Events involving physical motion or positioning, such as returning or being in a position.

name: Finance
definition: Events related to monetary support, such as funding.

name: Education
definition: Events related to attending, teaching at, or graduating from educational institutions, or the institutions themselves.

name: Award
definition: Events involving the receipt of prizes, medals, honors, or decorations.

name: Product
definition: Events related to the creation, production, or release of artistic or commercial works (e.g., films, albums).

name: Performance
definition: Events involving musical or theatrical presentation, such as concerts or singing.

name: Political
definition: Events related to elections, voting, or political campaigns.

name: Legal
definition: Events related to legal proceedings, charges, or court cases.

name: Military
definition: Events related to armed forces, battles, or military service.

name: Divorce
definition: Events involving the legal dissolution of a marriage.

name: Position
definition: Events involving the holding, appointment, or election to a specific rank, title, or office.

name: Sport
definition: Events related to participating in, winning, or losing organized athletic competitions, games, or races.

name: Relationship
definition: Events describing the personal connections, associations, or bonds between individuals, such as being a husband, wife, cousin, or mistress.

name: Role
definition: Events indicating the specific function, job title, or character assumed by a person within an organization, institution, or artistic production.

name: Manufacture
definition: Events involving the creation, production, or fabrication of goods and items.

name: Statement
definition: Events involving the act of declaring, claiming, reporting, or announcing information.

name: Residence
definition: Events describing the act of living, staying, or dwelling in a specific location.

name: Justice
definition: Events related to legal proceedings, law enforcement, punishment, and criminal justice, such as arrests, trials, sentencing, or being subject to penalties.

name: Operation
definition: Events involving the functioning, management, or running of organizations, systems, or facilities, or the state of being in effect.

name: Death
definition: Events describing the end of life, killing, or mortality.

name: Hostility
definition: Events involving physical attacks, fighting, aggression, or armed conflict between individuals or groups.

name: Creation
definition: Events involving the origin, production, or bringing into existence of artistic works, products, or entities.

name: Gathering
definition: Events where people come together in groups for social, official, or entertainment purposes, such as concerts, meetings, or parties.

name: Appointment
definition: Events involving the assignment of a person to a specific role, rank, or job, often officially or formally.
